content.short: Cult DAO empowers and funds those building toward a decentralized future.
content.description: Cult DAO is built around resisting centralization and backing initiatives that advance decentralization. It aims to accelerate the breakdown of the current global economic system and to fund revolutionaries pursuing that objective. The top 50 CULT stakers are designated as The Guardians. Guardians may submit proposals to the DAO, but they do not participate in voting. Voting is open to all CULT stakers who are not Guardians. Proposals pass based on the token share of Yes versus No.
content.meta: Cult DAO pursues the fight against centralization and supports projects that promote decentralization. Discover Cult DAO and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
